svg.title: End-to-End Journey, part A: the five-screen journey (as implemented)

g.text: End-to-End Journey, part A: the five-screen journey (as implemented)
Open on For you tab, Job Zones 1-3
Rank occupations by mean-centred cosine similarity
Open a job via For you, Browse or Search,
read its panel - what it involves, preparation,
Compute skills gap - any skill missing?
Completion - you already hold every skill,
essential at 3.5 or above, else desirable
Generate pathway, 3 steps plus target; show it
with new / deeper badges and provenance
Store profile id in this browser (not an account)
Continue in Figure 5b - My plan dashboard
